integrity: The finite lower bound and five-vertex census are exhaustive over connected unlabeled graphs, obtained by enumerating labeled graphs and quotienting exactly over all vertex permutations. All clustering values are rational and are recomputed from triangle and wedge counts; the displayed witness is also verified independently by hand-count identities.
scientific_limitations: The sharp boundary concerns connected simple undirected graphs compared at fixed order. The principal average-local convention excludes degree-0 and degree-1 vertices; an alternate zero-for-low-degree convention has the same sharp order and witness but a different five-vertex reversal count.
title: Average clustering and transitivity first reverse network rankings at five vertices
